name: ChaosPropDiff fields for select, hover end and key-up
body:
# New prop-diff fields

`ChaosPropDiff` gains `OnSelect` (`std::function<void(std::string)>`, a `<select>`'s chosen option), `OnHoverEnd`
(`std::function<void()>`), `OnKeyUp` (`std::function<void(std::string)>`) and `OnToggle`
(`std::function<void(bool)>`, a `<checkbox>`'s new state). `Checked` already exists. Options for a select travel in
`StringLists["options"]`, the selected option in `Strings["selected"]`.
